# Brand Voice — Fixture Clinic

## Tone

Calm, plain and unhurried. Short sentences. No exclamation marks.

## Voice

Speak as the clinic, not as a person. Say "we" rather than "I".

## What to avoid

- Marketing superlatives
- Clinical jargon without a plain-language explanation
- Pressure to book

## Notes

Invented for testing. This describes no real organisation.
